prompt: A roll fails in the original load direction, is rewound, and then stops at every cut mark. Which record best represents the outcome?
promptZh: 一卷紙以原本的捲向裝入時無法在記號停下；回捲後每個記號都能停下。哪一筆紀錄符合處理結果？

options.text: Correct wording; release direction does not need to be recorded.
options.zh: 文字正確；可不記錄放行時的方向。
options.whyZh: 紀錄必須註明放行時的捲向，文字正確不能取代該資訊。

options.text: Released as inward, because that was the direction on delivery.
options.zh: 以朝內狀態放行，因為收貨時是朝內。
options.whyZh: 紀錄應反映放行狀態，不是到貨狀態。

options.text: Sensor repaired; the roll was returned to stock unchanged.
options.zh: 感測器已修復；紙捲原樣退回庫存。
options.whyZh: 改變的是紙捲捲向，沒有修理感測器，也不是原樣放回。

options.text: Released after rewinding, with outward-facing labels.
options.zh: 回捲為標籤朝外後放行。
options.whyZh: 報告的對照試驗確立朝外是合宜方向，處理規則要求在放行紀錄採用檢查、回捲後的方向。

explanationZh: 報告的對照試驗確立朝外是合宜方向，處理規則要求在放行紀錄採用檢查、回捲後的方向。
evidence: A control roll wound outward then stopped at all of its cut marks. / Testing and the stock record must refer to the direction in which the roll was released, not the direction in which it arrived.

vocabulary.note: 此處代表檢查完成，可回到正常庫存。

difficultyRationale: 將對照試驗與庫存紀錄時點整合，區別原貌和最終狀態。
